description: PAID, per call: get the text of one named section of a federal Act or regulation held in ArrowMem's index. Send the act and the section. Returns the whole section text in English and French, its marginal note and historical note, the Justice Laws Website address, the consolidation date from the published XML, and the notice that this is a reproduction and not the official version. Schedules are not included. You are not charged when nothing matches.

act.description: The federal Act or regulation, by name or citation, for example its short title.

name: get_federal_law_section
